responsibility: Declares the central gm2 runtime-support API used by generated code and library modules. It covers module construction/deconstruction and dependency registration, installation and execution of initialization/termination procedures, program termination and diagnostic halt services, runtime string-length support, termination-state queries, and the noreturn helpers that generated code calls to raise standard language/runtime exceptions with source-location information.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the public interface for the M2RTS pair: it only declares the runtime entry points, procedure types, and exception-raising signatures that generated code and other modules call, whereas M2RTS.mod contains the state, list management, dependency delegation, and concrete RTExceptions-based implementations behind those declarations.
